calls.prompt: Create a new transparent 2x2 sprite sheet containing EXACTLY FOUR complete poses of the SAME closed BLUE-VIOLET MAGIC BOX from the FIRST reference. The four equal cells show 1 eyes normally open, 2 gently half-blinking, 3 softly closed eyelids in its original white eye shapes, 4 eyes open again with a tiny glance. Keep box body, lid and decoration geometrically IDENTICAL in all four cells. Do not rotate, resize or bend the box. FIRST reference gives its exact simple ordinary closed rectangular box shape, periwinkle blue-violet lid, medium violet-blue front, deep indigo side, thin pale lavender rim, slight three-quarter view. Add tasteful visibly engraved SILVER-LAVENDER MAGIC-BOX ORNAMENT: an inset double-line border around the lid with one large four-pointed silver star inside a thin diamond at the lid's center; a few simple symmetric curled silver corner flourishes and short geometric border lines on the front and right face. Give the box the crafted look of a real stage magician's prop, but keep it flat 2D game art and simplify the number of lines so the large patterns remain visible at 100px. No photorealistic woodgrain, heavy texture, gradients, metallic rendering or glow. Ornament must be consistent across ALL four cells, no flickering patterns. The front only retains the Ram's distinctive paired adjacent WHITE OVAL eyes and black pupils from SECOND reference, low on the front, decorations do not touch or obstruct eyes. Absolutely NO green leaves, leaf symbols, red body, rounded Ram silhouette, nose, mouth, limbs, animals, ribbons, hats, smoke or extra objects. Only a normal ornate closed magic box with the original eye design. Use roughly #7A6DE6 on lid, #6556BC front, #433579 side, #D2C9F3 silver-lavender ornaments. Exactly2columns2rows equal cells, entire box centered at same scale and baseline in all four, with ample 15% transparent margins in each cell. Completely clean transparent background, no shadows, text, labels, grid lines, borders around the sheet, fake checkerboard or detached noisy pixels. Newly illustrated reusable prop animation candidate, not an official asset.
